checks.statement: Do not show a disabled FAB; omit it when its represented action is unavailable. Maintain at least 3:1 contrast between icon and container.
checks.condition: When an action is unavailable or selecting FAB colors.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Interaction & style: Do not show a disabled FAB; omit it when its represented action is unavailable. Maintain at least 3:1 contrast

evidence.result: The FAB specimen renders the button for every component state. `Attributes()` sets aria-disabled="true" when disabled but does not set the native disabled attribute or omit the button for an unavailable action.

implementation.notes: The code exposes a disabled-state specimen rather than omitting an unavailable FAB; the required omission rule is not implemented by the component/page path. The stated 3:1 contrast is token-driven and not established by this missing-state finding.

evidence.result: The specimen uses a native button, and the shared FAB attributes set type=button and aria-label="Create".

implementation.notes: The rendered control has a programmatic name describing the represented create action and native button focus/activation semantics.

implementation.notes: This specimen exposes a focusable, activatable named button. The additional extended-FAB expand/minimize behavior is not part of the standard FAB path.
